_description: One document per authenticated user. Document ID = Firebase Auth UID. Created automatically on first sign-in via a Cloud Function or FlutterFlow action.

uid.note: Mirrors the Firestore document ID for easy client-side access

display_name.note: Can be anonymous ('Cyclist #4821') for users who skip profile setup

email.note: Null for anonymous sign-in. Never display in UI.

subscription_status.note: Gate premium FAQs and offline maps on 'active'. Updated by Stripe webhook → Cloud Function.

subscription_expires_at.note: Null for free users. Check server-side; never trust client-side date.

stripe_customer_id.note: Set by Stripe webhook. Never expose in client queries.

total_points.note: Incremented server-side (Cloud Function) when a quiz is answered correctly to prevent cheating

visited_location_slugs.note: Appended when the geofence is breached for the first time. Powers the 'X of Y landmarks visited' progress bar.

completed_quiz_ids.note: Stores Firestore document IDs from the quizzes collection to prevent re-showing answered questions

preferred_language.note: Used for future multi-language content. Default 'en'.

push_notifications_enabled.note: Synced with OS permission status. If false, skip showing prompts.

fcm_token.note: Firebase Cloud Messaging token. Refreshed on app launch.

last_active_at.note: Updated on app foreground — helps identify churned users

_security_rules_note: A user may only read and write their OWN document. Rule: allow read, write: if request.auth.uid == resource.data.uid. Stripe-controlled fields (stripe_customer_id, subscription_status, subscription_expires_at) must only be writable by Cloud Functions using Admin SDK — add a check: if request.auth.token.admin == true for those fields.
